execute_skill_with_video: execute a high-level skill action in the environment and record a video of the skill run
create_debug_video_util: create a DebugVideoUtil instance from an EnvironmentInterface to capture and save third-person skill run videos
store_frames_for_video: store observation frames with agent action text overlays for later video compilation
make_video_from_frames: make an MP4 video from stored frames using imageio and save it to the output directory
combine_agent_frames: combine multiple agent third-person RGB observation frames into a single split-screen composite image
